WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as cnt
  FROM player_college
  GROUP BY college_id
),
with_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    cnt,
    (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM college_counts) as overall_avg,
    (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM college_counts) as overall_sum
  FROM college_counts
)
SELECT
  AVG(cnt) as avg_count_above_average,
  AVG(cnt) / overall_sum as avg_ratio_to_total,
  AVG(cnt) - overall_avg as avg_excess_over_average
FROM with_avg
WHERE cnt > overall_avg
